entry.title: New: dsh-rule-engine
entry.summary: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections). Exact install spec: dsh-rule-engine. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
